headline: Happy Birthday to the absolute love of my life 🎉🎊🥂
letter:
Happy birthday, my loverrrrrrr! ❤️

I'm grateful for you and for the person you are. I hope this new year brings you so much happiness, growth, peace, success, and all the beautiful things you've been working towards.

I pray that life is kind to you, that your efforts pay off, and that you always have reasons to smile. You deserve good things, and I hope this year gives you plenty of them.

I'm happy I get to do life with you, make memories with you, laugh with you, and occasionally disturb your peace. 😂

How does it feel to be old 🌚🌚

Here's to another beautiful year of being you. I love you. Happy birthday, baby! ❤️

I loveeeeee you so muccccccch
notes: The way you make me laugh
Being my automatic handbag and a plus one anywhere
The way you care for your family
You're hardworking, so I know you'd always look out for us
